title: ALD-52

attribution.author: Josie Kins
attribution.text: Forked from Subjective Effect Documentation work by Josie Kins, August 2016.

notes.overview: Effects vary widely by individual, dose, and context.
notes.cognitive:
In comparison to other lysergamides such as LSD and 1P-LSD, ALD-52 is less stimulating and is associated with a more relaxed mental state.

The most prominent of these cognitive effects generally include:

effects.name: Drifting
effects.description: (melting, breathing, morphing and flowing) - In comparison to other psychedelics such as LSD, the distortions produced by ALD-52 can appear much more sharp and life-like.

Geometry.note: The geometry of ALD-52 is very similar to that of its close relative LSD. The geometry of ALD-52 is suspected (but not confirmed) to lead to level 8A geometry (similar to LSD).

effects.name: Internal hallucinations
effects.description: (autonomous entities; settings, sceneries, and landscapes; alterations in perspective and scenarios and plots)
